about: Hand-written mutants for the integration and end-to-end layers, run by scripts/ci/layer-mutation.mjs (npm run test:mutation:layers).

Stryker (workers/oursharedevents/stryker.conf.mjs) mutates the guards for the node-project specs. It cannot switch a mutant on inside workerd, where the integration specs run (vitest.workers.config.mts), or inside the `wrangler dev` the journeys drive (playwright.mobile.config.ts). So each mutant here is one small fault in a rule the product promises, written by hand, and the specs in `kill` at its `layer` must fail on it.

Each `find` must occur exactly once in its `file` (the runner refuses the catalog otherwise, so a mutant cannot go stale silently). Integration kill specs must run in the Workers runtime, not the node project (vitest.node-specs.mjs).
The gate is every mutant killed. A mutant that survives is a rule that layer would let ship: add the case that catches it, never drop the mutant.

mutants.rule: Never who, only how many: a count under 5 is withheld, for a brand's own admin too.
mutants.find: if (n < floor) return { count: null, suppressed: true, floor };
mutants.replace: if (false) return { count: null, suppressed: true, floor };

mutants.rule: A sponsor shows only when it accepted and the organizer accepted.
An admin write that is not GET, HEAD or OPTIONS must come from the same site.
A public event response is an allowlist of fields, never a spread of the row.
A vote names a winner only once enough different people have voted (the secret floor, 10 to 14); below it the set reads too close.
mutants.find: AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vote_participants p WHERE p.set_id = vote_sets.id) >= secret_floor

mutants.rule: A vote names a winner only when the first leads the second by the secret margin; a near tie reads too close.
The SharedReport says nothing while a sponsor's display count is under 5.
mutants.find: if (n < floor) return { count: null, suppressed: true, floor };
mutants.replace: if (false) return { count: null, suppressed: true, floor };

mutants.rule: A sponsor placed on an event but not yet answered is on none of the event's surfaces (event page, lists, landing, TV).
